description: 《Hold My Hand》描寫一份在痛苦與恐懼中，仍然願意陪伴、守護與支持對方的深厚感情。歌中的主角看見心愛的人正承受傷害與內心的掙扎，希望對方能勇敢說出自己的需要，無須獨自面對困難。她承諾無論未來多麼艱難，都會緊握對方的手，陪伴他走過人生的低谷。歌曲亦鼓勵人們勇敢流淚、接納脆弱，並相信時間能逐漸撫平傷痛。反覆出現的「Hold My Hand」象徵信任、希望與永不放棄的支持。最終，《Hold My Hand》傳達的是愛、勇氣與心靈的治癒：即使生命充滿不確定與挑戰，只要願意敞開心扉、彼此扶持，便能在最黑暗的時刻找到希望，重新獲得前進的力量。

vocabulary.usage: 形容身體持續疼痛；常說 aching arms / feet / back。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: After carrying the heavy drum all afternoon, my arms were aching.
The train was aching at the station for ten minutes.
Our school will aching a new library next year.
Please aching the lights before the show begins.
optionExplanations: 搬了一下午沉重的鼓，手臂痠痛，aching 用來描述持續疼痛。
火車停靠應說 waiting 或 staying，aching 不能表示停留。
aching 不是「興建」的動詞，應說 build。
要打開燈應說 turn on，不能用 aching 當動詞。
vocabulary.explanation: 搬了一下午沉重的鼓，手臂痠痛，aching 用來描述持續疼痛。

vocabulary.usage: 常用於安慰、擁抱或保護；pull + 人 + close。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The pilot pulled the airport close before the plane landed.
The photographer pulled the sunshine close to take a brighter photo.
When her brother came home after a year, she pulled him close and hugged him.
The museum pulled the history close at nine o’clock.
optionExplanations: 機師不能把整座機場拉近；要說 flew toward the airport。
陽光不能像人一樣被拉近；可以說 moved into the sunlight。
久別重逢時把弟弟拉近擁抱，符合片語用法。
這裡想表達開館，應說 opened，不能用 pull someone close。
vocabulary.explanation: 久別重逢時把弟弟拉近擁抱，符合片語用法。

vocabulary.meaning: 放手；不再抓住；也可指放下情緒
vocabulary.usage: 常用 let go of + 名詞，例如 let go of the rope / fear。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The guide told us to let go the map of the city.
When the boat reached the dock, Noah let go of the rope.
After the concert, Mia let go at the piano for three hours.
Our coach let go to the team before the big game.
optionExplanations: 若要說放開地圖，應說 let go of the map，少了 of。
船靠岸時鬆開繩子，let go of 用法正確。
彈鋼琴要用 played，let go at 不表示演奏。
對球隊講話應說 spoke to，let go to 並無此意。
vocabulary.explanation: 船靠岸時鬆開繩子，let go of 用法正確。

vocabulary.usage: raise 是及物動詞；raise your head 是把頭往上抬。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The city raised its head into a new subway line.
At the bank, I raised my head for fifty dollars from the machine.
The singer raised her head the song on the radio.
The librarian raised her head to see who had entered the quiet room.
optionExplanations: 興建捷運線應說 built，不能用 raise its head into。
從提款機領錢應說 withdrew，不能用 raise my head for。
播放歌曲應說 played，raise her head 不能直接接歌曲當受詞。
聽到有人進圖書館便抬頭查看，意思自然正確。
vocabulary.explanation: 聽到有人進圖書館便抬頭查看，意思自然正確。

vocabulary.usage: 用於需要時間改善、適應或發展的情況。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: We gave it time to the ticket office at noon.
The dancer gave it time in a box to send to her friend.
You may feel nervous at your new job, but give it time.
Our teacher gave it time the students for the exam.
optionExplanations: 買票應說 went to the ticket office；give it time 不是「前往」。
時間不是能裝箱寄送的物品；此處應說 sent a gift。
新工作需要適應，勸對方別急很自然。
若指給學生更多考試時間，應說 gave the students more time。
vocabulary.explanation: 新工作需要適應，勸對方別急很自然。

vocabulary.usage: 常指看不見明顯的問題或事實；be blind to + 名詞。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The mayor was blind to the broken streetlights until people complained.
The painter was blind to a brush to finish the picture.
My cousin is blind to play the violin every Thursday.
The hotel is blind to the beach by a short bus ride.
optionExplanations: 市長先前沒有注意到壞掉的路燈，blind to 表忽略問題。
畫畫需用 used a brush，blind to 不能表示使用工具。
要說學小提琴應用 learning to play，blind to 不能接原形動詞。
要說旅館離海灘很近，可用 close to，blind to 不是距離。
vocabulary.explanation: 市長先前沒有注意到壞掉的路燈，blind to 表忽略問題。

vocabulary.usage: 可以 whisper to someone 或 whisper a secret；不是大聲喊叫。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The actor whispered so loudly that people outside the stadium heard him.
At the surprise party, Ella whispered the plan to her cousin.
The mechanic whispered the old engine with a new part.
Our class whispered a race across the school field.
optionExplanations: whisper 指小聲說話，吼到場外都聽見與詞義衝突。
驚喜派對怕被發現，小聲告知計畫符合 whisper。
修引擎應說 repaired，whisper 不是「修理」。
舉辦比賽應說 held a race；whisper 不能表示舉辦。
vocabulary.explanation: 驚喜派對怕被發現，小聲告知計畫符合 whisper。

vocabulary.meaning: 對某人放棄希望、不再支持
vocabulary.usage: give up on + 人；不同於 give up + 活動（停止做某事）。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: My aunt gave up on the bus at 8:30 and arrived downtown.
The artist gave up on the wall a bright blue color.
I gave up on to my grandmother yesterday.
The science team did not give up on Leo, even after his robot failed twice.
optionExplanations: 若指搭公車應說 got on the bus，give up on 不是上車。
幫牆上色應說 painted the wall，give up on 不能表示塗色。
give up on 後需接名詞或 V-ing，不能接 to my grandmother 表示拜訪。
即使機器人失敗兩次，隊友仍不放棄 Leo，搭配正確。
vocabulary.explanation: 即使機器人失敗兩次，隊友仍不放棄 Leo，搭配正確。

vocabulary.meaning: 在某人需要時陪伴、支持他
vocabulary.usage: 指情感或實際支持，不只是地點上的「在那裡」。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: This phone was there for the battery for two hours.
When I lost the chess final, my friends were there for me.
The stage was there for a purple song last night.
The flight was there for Tokyo at seven o’clock.
optionExplanations: 要說電池續航，應說 the battery lasted two hours。
西洋棋決賽失利時朋友陪伴支持，符合 be there for someone。
舞台不能為歌曲提供情感支持；可說 the band performed a song。
班機飛往東京應說 left for Tokyo，be there for 不表示出發。
vocabulary.explanation: 西洋棋決賽失利時朋友陪伴支持，符合 be there for someone。

vocabulary.usage: promise + 人 + that 子句，或 promise to + 原形動詞。
vocabulary.prompt: 哪一句正確使用這個詞語？
options: The tour guide promised us that we would get back before sunset.
The reporter promised the camera across the river.
My brother promised to the library at five and borrowed a book.
The runner promised a mountain in just ten minutes.
optionExplanations: 導遊承諾日落前回來，promise + 人 + that 子句正確。
要說把攝影機帶過河應說 carried，promise 不是「搬運」。
若指前往圖書館應說 went to；promise to 後需要動詞原形。
跑者爬上山應說 climbed a mountain，promise 並非攀爬。
vocabulary.explanation: 導遊承諾日落前回來，promise + 人 + that 子句正確。
